name: primary cutaneous T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
description: A T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma arising from the skin. Representative examples include mycosis fungoides and primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

warnings.detail: benefits are no longer considered to outweigh its risks

Increases the incidence of gallstones and cholecystitis, drug-induced cardiac arrhythmias, cardiomegaly, angina, claudication and thromboembolic phenomena. It also enhances the effects and toxicity of other acidic drugs and it is implicated in the incidence of various tumours
